_doc: Log-specific disruption scenarios for loan_model/disruptions.py (Phase 5). Mechanisms are generic (outage, routing_surge); this file maps them onto BPIC2017 stages, transitions and work items. All intensities are assumed and swept (Modules 2-3/Assumptions_Table.md section 3). Durations in hours; outage lengths come from a short/long mixture the agent never sees.

D1_offer_outage._doc: Offer dispatch system down: cases that finish the complete stage cannot get their offer sent.

D2_telephony_outage._doc: Contact-centre telephony down: call sessions cannot start.

D3_documents_surge._doc: Document portal fault: more validations find the file incomplete, and the customer's upload is held up by the faulty portal (upload_delay_h, wall-clock, added to the incomplete visit). Each case routed to incomplete during the surge is a decision.

sla_alert._doc: D6: a case blocked by a disruption and left waiting gets a second decision when its slack (stage deadline - age) falls to the threshold.

recovery._doc: Phase 6: recovery actions. All values assumed and swept (Assumptions_Table.md section 4). Costs are kappa x c_p (c_p = 1). Times in working hours for handling/retry (only working days and hours count), wall-clock hours for customer-side delays.

allowed._sla_risk: an SLA-risk alert allows the actions of the failure that blocked the case

retry._doc: Try again after a short delay; during an outage it only succeeds once the service is back. For missing documents: an automatic re-fetch finds them with documents_success_p, so the case skips the incomplete loop. At most max_per_case retries per case (then retry is masked), so an outage cannot be retried hour after hour.

offer_dispatch_outage._doc: send the offer through the online-only channel (O_Sent (online only), used for 4.9% of offers in the log); with rework_p the customer misses it and it has to be re-sent later

telephony_outage._doc: contact the customer in writing instead of by phone: the call is skipped but the customer responds later

escalate._doc: a senior team handles the step manually (offer dispatch, call, or completing the file). Scarce: capacity slots shared by all cases, masked when none is free. Capacity sized against the real fraud team (W_Assess potential fraud: 34 qualified workers, ~1% of cases).

reassign._doc: missing documents: a caseworker chases the documents directly (the case skips the portal delay) and the case's incomplete-file calls go to the front of the queue (fastest free qualified worker), ahead of other cases.

training_cycle._doc: Phase 8: training/evaluation cycle of (scenario, level, duration_h) cells. The disruption length is fixed per cell instead of drawn from the level's mixture (the agent still never observes it). Outage levels only differ in their length distribution, so level 2 is used for D1/D2; for D3 the level sets surge magnitude and upload delay, the cell sets the surge length.

robustness_cells._doc: benchmark-only cells with the length drawn from the level's distribution (between and beyond the grid)
